--- title: "Stage 1 — universal Tier-1 sweep (report)" subtitle: "$t_{\\mathrm{oxide}} \\times \\beta \\times$ oxide dispersion, sample SS\\_12-3" author: "Bolu / Josu" date: 2026-05-09 format: html: code-fold: false toc: true toc-depth: 2 embed-resources: true fig-width: 11 fig-height: 5 jupyter: rcwa-venv execute: cache: false echo: true warning: false --- > **Decoupled report.** Reads the outputs of [bin/run_stage1.py](../bin/run_stage1.py) > from [runs/stage1_universals/](../runs/stage1_universals/) — does **not** run RCWA. > > If the output directory does not yet exist, run the script first: > > ``` > python sweep/bin/run_stage1.py --parallel 4 > ``` # 1. Load results ::: {#cell-load .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import sys from pathlib import Path import numpy as np import pandas as pd import matplotlib.pyplot as plt plt.rcParams.update({ "text.usetex": True, "font.family": "serif", "font.size": 9, "axes.titlesize": 10, "axes.labelsize": 10, "legend.fontsize": 8, "text.latex.preamble": r"\usepackage{amsmath}\usepackage{amssymb}", }) sys.path.insert(0, str(Path("./lib"))) import sweep_runner as sr OUT = Path("./sweep/runs/stage1_universals") results_csv = OUT / "results.csv" decision_txt = OUT / "decision.txt" traces_dir = OUT / "traces" assert results_csv.exists(), f"Run `python sweep/bin/run_stage1.py` first — {results_csv} not found." df = pd.read_csv(results_csv).sort_values(["oxide_dispersion", "t_oxide_um", "beta_deg"]).reset_index(drop=True) print(f"{len(df)} simulations in results.csv") df.head(10)[["t_oxide_um", "beta_deg", "oxide_dispersion", "Rdet_chi2_red", "Rdet_RMSE", "Rdet_pearson_r"]].round(4) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` 84 simulations in results.csv ``` ::: ::: {#load .cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ```{=html}

Heatmaps — χ²_red over (t_oxide, β) per oxide dispersion ::: {#cell-heatmaps .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} oxides = sorted(df["oxide_dispersion"].unique()) fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, len(oxides), figsize=(5*len(oxides), 4.5), constrained_layout=True) if len(oxides) == 1: ax = [ax] for i, oxide in enumerate(oxides): sub = df[df["oxide_dispersion"] == oxide] pivot = sub.pivot(index="t_oxide_um", columns="beta_deg", values="Rdet_chi2_red") im = ax[i].imshow(np.log10(pivot.values), aspect="auto", origin="lower", cmap="viridis_r") ax[i].set_xticks(range(len(pivot.columns))) ax[i].set_xticklabels([f"{b:g}" for b in pivot.columns]) ax[i].set_yticks(range(len(pivot.index))) ax[i].set_yticklabels([f"{t:g}" for t in pivot.index]) ax[i].set_xlabel(r"$\beta\;[^{\circ}]$") ax[i].set_ylabel(r"$t_{\mathrm{oxide}}\;[\mu\mathrm{m}]$") title_oxide = oxide.replace("_", r"\_") ax[i].set_title(rf"$\log_{{10}} \chi^2_{{\mathrm{{red}}}}(R_{{\mathrm{{det}}}})$ — {title_oxide}") cbar = plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax[i]) cbar.set_label(r"$\log_{10}\,\chi^2_{\mathrm{red}}$") # mark the per-oxide minimum j_t, j_b = np.unravel_index(np.argmin(pivot.values), pivot.shape) ax[i].plot(j_b, j_t, marker="*", ms=18, color="white", mec="red", mew=1.5) plt.show() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ![](stage1_report_files/figure-html/heatmaps-output-1.png){#heatmaps width=970 height=443} ::: ::: # 3. Best configuration overall ::: {#best .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} best_idx = df["Rdet_chi2_red"].idxmin() best = df.loc[best_idx] print(f"Best config (argmin χ²_red across all {len(df)} runs):") print(f" t_oxide = {best['t_oxide_um']:.3f} µm") print(f" beta = {best['beta_deg']:g}°") print(f" oxide_dispersion = {best['oxide_dispersion']}") print(f" χ²_red(R_det) = {best['Rdet_chi2_red']:.2f}") print(f" RMSE = {best['Rdet_RMSE']:.4f}") print(f" Pearson r = {best['Rdet_pearson_r']:.4f}") print() print("Top 5 by χ²_red:") top = df.nsmallest(5, "Rdet_chi2_red")[ ["t_oxide_um", "beta_deg", "oxide_dispersion", "Rdet_chi2_red", "Rdet_RMSE", "Rdet_pearson_r"] ].round(4) print(top.to_string(index=False)) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Best config (argmin χ²_red across all 84 runs): t_oxide = 0.900 µm beta = 1° oxide_dispersion = HS_caliente χ²_red(R_det) = 138.83 RMSE = 0.1178 Pearson r = 0.9723 Top 5 by χ²_red: t_oxide_um beta_deg oxide_dispersion Rdet_chi2_red Rdet_RMSE Rdet_pearson_r 0.9 1.0 HS_caliente 138.8257 0.1178 0.9723 0.9 2.0 HS_caliente 138.8257 0.1178 0.9723 0.9 5.0 HS_caliente 138.8257 0.1178 0.9723 0.9 1.0 RS_frio 153.8106 0.1240 0.9649 0.9 2.0 RS_frio 153.8106 0.1240 0.9649 ``` ::: ::: # 4. Best curve vs experiment ::: {#cell-best-curve .cell execution_count=4} ``` {.python .cell-code} from scipy.interpolate import interp1d cfg_best = sr.SimConfig( period_um=12.9, A_um=1.5, t_oxide_um=float(best["t_oxide_um"]), oxide_dispersion=str(best["oxide_dispersion"]), theta_deg=30.0, phi_sim_deg=89.0, harmonics=39, slices=50, beta_deg=float(best["beta_deg"]), wavelengths_um=np.arange(3.0, 25.0, 0.25), ) stem = cfg_best.filename_stem() avg_best = pd.read_csv(traces_dir / stem / f"AVG_{stem}.csv") EXP_DIR = Path("../data/experimental") exp_files = sorted(EXP_DIR.glob("12-3_30_0_*.CSV")) exp_repeats = [] for f in exp_files: raw = pd.read_csv(f, header=None, names=["wn", "R_pct"]) raw = raw[raw["R_pct"] > 0].copy() raw["lambda_um"] = 1e4 / raw["wn"] raw["R"] = raw["R_pct"] / 100.0 raw = raw.sort_values("lambda_um").reset_index(drop=True) exp_repeats.append((raw["lambda_um"].values, raw["R"].values)) lam_sim = avg_best["x"].values R_stack = np.array([ interp1d(l, r, bounds_error=False, fill_value=np.nan, assume_sorted=True)(lam_sim) for l, r in exp_repeats ]) R_exp_mean = np.nanmean(R_stack, axis=0) R_exp_std = np.nanstd(R_stack, axis=0, ddof=1) fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4.5), constrained_layout=True) ax.fill_between(lam_sim, R_exp_mean - R_exp_std, R_exp_mean + R_exp_std, color="C2", alpha=0.20) ax.plot(lam_sim, R_exp_mean, color="C2", lw=2.0, label=r"$\langle R \rangle_{\mathrm{exp}}\!\pm\!\sigma$") ax.plot(avg_best["x"], avg_best["R_det"], color="black", lw=2.0, label=rf"$\langle R_{{\mathrm{{det}}}} \rangle_{{\mathrm{{sim}}}}\;(t_{{\mathrm{{ox}}}}={best['t_oxide_um']:.2f}, \beta={best['beta_deg']:g}^{{\circ}})$") ax.set_xlabel(r"$\lambda \;[\mu\mathrm{m}]$") ax.set_ylabel(r"$R$") ax.set_title(r"Best Tier-1 universal — sample SS\_12-3, $\theta=30^\circ$, $\varphi_{\mathrm{exp}}=0^\circ$") ax.grid(True, alpha=0.4) ax.legend(loc="lower right", framealpha=0.85) plt.show() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ![](stage1_report_files/figure-html/best-curve-output-1.png){#best-curve width=779 height=443} ::: ::: # 5.
